artifacts.summary: Seven-phase plan proving ChainComplete FrameClass.Dense ∅ via an L⁻ MCS layer, canonical relations, a Burgess-style ℚ-chronicle construction, and a chainSat truth lemma across five new Conservativity modules, with the three corollaries, ledger/C14 pins, and the docstring revisions the proof forces.

memory_candidates.content: ChainValidIn (Conservativity/FragmentAxiomatization.lean) quantifies over bundles of copies of ONE ordered group D, so any L⁻ completeness route must build a countable chain directly (Burgess §2.5 ω-stage construction on ℚ from the canonical G-relation, with a Finset-supported stage, a disjunctive placement lemma, and an interpolation lemma) rather than taking the full canonical model plus generated submodel plus bulldozing — the latter yields uncountable, pairwise non-isomorphic R-components that do not land in the quantifier. The bundle index is one canBox-class of chronicles; the ◇-witness case of the truth lemma is closed by chronicle existence through the witness MCS. The Formula-typed canonical models (Core/, BXCanonical/) cannot be imported for this: the route is circular via the very forward-conservativity statement being proved, so the L⁻ side gets its own MCS layer mirroring Core/MaximalConsistent.lean.
